title: Bulk Receptionist Job Collector input
description: Collect high-volume US home-service receptionist, CSR, dispatcher, and scheduling postings with full descriptions and cross-run history.

mode.title: Collection mode
mode.description: Recent is intended for frequent scheduled runs. Backfill searches a wider historical window.

states.title: US states
states.description: Leave empty to search all 50 states plus Washington, DC.

roleFamilies.title: Role families
roleFamilies.description: Leave empty to collect every supported receptionist-adjacent role family.

tradeBundles.title: Home-service trade bundles
tradeBundles.description: Leave the defaults to cover the complete home-service taxonomy.

partitionIndex.title: Partition index
partitionIndex.description: Zero-based partition used to split national coverage across frequent runs.

partitionCount.title: Number of partitions
partitionCount.description: Use 4 with four daily schedules. Each state is covered once per day.

maxSerpRequests.title: Maximum SERP pages per run
maxSerpRequests.description: Hard discovery-cost ceiling for this run.

revisitAfterDays.title: Days before refetching a known URL
revisitAfterDays.description: Known descriptions are served from cache until this interval passes.

includeSnippetOnly.title: Keep blocked jobs using their search snippet
